name: Rowan Inter-Regional Border Battle
where: Logan Township, NJ · host Rowan · Gloucester County DREAM Park
headline: Rowan Inter-Regional Border Battle
summary: Final: Men: Mount Union won the championship race with 70 points, ahead of host Rowan (83) and Cortland State (126), and Utica's Bennett Melita won in 26:39.1. Women: Swarthmore scored 77 to beat Cortland State (97) and Christopher Newport (113), and Misericordia's Madison Hedglin won in 22:28.6; No. 2 NYU placed ninth (289).
